chunks: On the day when He will call you, and you will answer with His praises and imagine you did not tarry but a while.
ai.seo_question: What do people imagine about the duration of their stay when Allah calls them on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Isra, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment, where they are compelled to offer praise (hamd) to Allah despite their previous denial. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, note that 'little time' refers to the brevity of worldly life relative to the eternity of the Hereafter, emphasizing the suddenness of the reckoning. This serves as a warning against the illusion of permanence in this world and the inevitability of divine accountability.
